milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Checks that the player has navigated to the jungle-themed area in the NE quadrant (centered around ~11 ~1 ~-8) with actual jungle biome set via /fillbiome, and is facing the jungle trees. max_distance=8 allows detection from the edge of the jungle zone.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. Checks that the player has navigated close to the potted_bamboo block at ~11 ~0 ~-10 within the jungle area and is facing it. Tight distance (4 blocks) ensures the player has actually entered the jungle zone and spotted the pot among the trees.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Checks that the player has navigated near the gray_wall_banner at ~-9 ~2 ~-4 (mounted on the south face of the workshop wall, visible from the south approach) and is facing it. Target updated to [-9, 2, -4] to match corrected wall banner placement.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Checks that the player has navigated inside the workshop to be near the fletching_table at ~-8 ~0 ~-8 and is facing it. Tight distance (4 blocks) ensures the player has entered through the doorway rather than just being near the exterior wall.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Checks that the player has navigated near the orange_concrete pillar at ~-12 ~1 ~5 (the farm area landmark) and is facing it. This confirms the player has located the farm area where wheat must be harvested.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because this is a mine/remove task — verifying the block no longer exists is the most direct check. The dark_oak_sign at ~-10 ~0 ~-9 should be removed after mining. Box is ±2 blocks around the sign location to avoid false positives while accommodating any coordinate imprecision.

Uses inventory_has because crafted items end up in inventory. The dark_oak_door requires 6 dark_oak_planks in a 2x3 pattern at the crafting table. Player has 8 dark_oak_planks pre-given (6 for door + 2 reserved for sword). This is the preferred rule for craft tasks.

Uses inventory_has because crafted items end up in inventory. The wooden_sword requires 2 planks (any type — dark_oak_planks work) + 1 stick. Player has 2 remaining dark_oak_planks after door craft and 8 sticks. This is the preferred rule for craft tasks.

Uses inventory_has because crafted items end up in inventory. The hay_block requires 9 wheat in a 3x3 pattern. Wheat is NOT pre-given — player must harvest from the mature wheat field (20 blocks at age=7, minimum yield 20 wheat). This is the preferred rule for craft tasks.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (two rules) because build tasks require verifying placed blocks. Rule 1: at least 12 oak_fence blocks forming a meaningful enclosure perimeter (minimum for a small rectangular pen). Rule 2: at least 1 oak_fence_gate placed as the pen entrance. Both must be in the SE building area. 12 fences is chosen as the minimum for a functional 4x3 or 3x4 enclosure minus the gate position.

Uses count_in_box_at_least because build tasks require verifying placed blocks. Checks for at least 2 tripwire_hook blocks in the SE building area. A functional tripwire trap requires hooks on both ends of a tripwire line — requiring 2 ensures both ends are placed rather than just a single decorative block. Stone mounting blocks are provided in the scene at ~8 ~0 ~8 and ~12 ~0 ~8 for hook attachment.
